sections.title: A new postposition
sections.content: *keresztül* ("through") is a postposition — it comes AFTER the noun it goes with, not before like an English preposition. It pairs naturally with *-n/-on/-en/-ön*, the same suffix you already use for "on".

items.english: I'm getting to know Zsófia through Petra.

items.spanish: A munkahelyen keresztül sok emberrel ismerkedünk.
items.english: We get to know a lot of people through work.

sections.content: You know postpositions from A1 (*alatt*, *mellett*, *előtt*): like them, *keresztül* is its own word after the noun. What is new is that the noun carries *-n/-on/-en/-ön* before it.
